construction.offset_method: Original rzedne.Kadlub PCHIP evaluation of PR.RZEDNE; no generic hull function
construction.retained_hull: aft and midbody to staggered fracture at s~+2.35m

guide_matrix.01: Merchant hull family of the c.1710 reference; wreck damage and salvage state are game inference.
guide_matrix.02: Exact source offset-family evaluator; length/breadth transform and stranded datum recorded.
guide_matrix.03: Closed strakes with capped splintered ends; separate keel, keelson, inner frames and wales.
guide_matrix.04: Source sheer/camber, discrete deck planking and genuine absent boards around hatch.
guide_matrix.05: Broken mainmast diameter from Steel M=(L+B)/2 and D=M/36; no surviving rig claimed.
guide_matrix.06: N/A: no standing sail rig survives. Broken spar retained as separate timber.
guide_matrix.07: N/A: no operable sailing rig or running rigging survives on this wreck.
guide_matrix.08: No cloth to audit; separate closed timber fragments, source-derived PBR textures and grain-aligned UVs.
guide_matrix.09: Separate plumb suspended ladder on real supports, casks, chest, book and compass anchors; accessible salvage hold.
guide_matrix.10: Reproducible Blender script using original reference PCHIP module and numeric data.
guide_matrix.11: CAD/paper artefact not requested; underlying reference stations and numeric transforms retained for reproduction.
guide_matrix.12: Reference hull length/breadth/depth parameters are transformed before constructing new planks, frames and decks.
guide_matrix.13: Closed-solid, normals, indices, UV, material, source/GLB and walking audits required on actual exports.
guide_matrix.14: Separate physics geometry, glTF axes/metres, interaction anchors, climb endpoints, LODs.

deviations: The source guide does not specify this wreck; damage, hold, salvage and ladder layout are explicit game inference.
The source model's broad flat transom family is retained; no historical identity for the wreck is asserted.
The game's deck/sole/draft values are mapped to a stranded vertical datum; they are not a new hydrostatic floating draft.
No captain cabin survives; no fabricated room is added.
Hull fairness is inherited from the documented source offset family, including its disclosed limitations below the aft waterline.
Procedural MIT guide textures with colour-weathering transform; not photographic CC0 texture set.

Fallen spar rests on two afterdeck cradles and the forward retained framing.
Ladder rungs join stringers; stringers are fastened to the hatch side.
